name: NXT Affiliate
author: NXTWEBSITE

sections.description:
NXT Affiliate adds a frontend affiliate registration form and an admin workflow for reviewing, filtering, and managing affiliate applications inside WordPress.

Features include:

  • Shortcode-powered affiliate application form.
  • Server-side validation with nonce protection.
  • Admin applications screen with filters, bulk actions, notes, and status updates.
  • Configurable settings for the registration experience.
  • Translation-ready strings and WordPress coding standards-friendly PHP.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open NXT Affiliate > Settings and configure the registration options.
  4. Add the [nxt_affiliate_registration] shortcode to any page where you want to display the affiliate application form.
sections.faq:
How do I show the affiliate application form?

Add the [nxt_affiliate_registration] shortcode to a page or post.

Where are applications managed?

Applications are available in the WordPress admin area under NXT Affiliate > Applications.
